title: Volo's Ersatz Eye

sources.title: Volo's Ersatz Eye
markers: '''Volo's Ersatz Eye''' is a common item.

summary: Volo’s surgery grants permanent See Invisibility.

fields.Permanent effect: With the eye implanted, invisible creatures within 30 ft make Dexterity saves against DC 8 + the wearer’s Perception modifier or lose Invisibility. The looted eye is an inert item.
fields.Acquisition: Rescue Volo and invite him to camp, then consent to his surgery. It is irreversible. Unavailable to Wyll, Minthara, or a character who already Paid the Price to Auntie Ethel.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
